property_summary: For any caller that is the admin (the deployer) and any address a, calling setOwner(a) must make the public getter c.owner() return exactly a; the mutant instead sets owner to msg.sender, so it violates the rule whenever a != admin.
change_summary: Replace the assignment `owner = _owner;` with `owner = msg.sender;` so setOwner sets owner to the caller instead of the argument.
